_meta.captured_via: The store's WooPayments log, WEBHOOK RECEIVED lines, during the lane run. The store logger redacts emails, names, note names and URLs, so each redacted field the note handler reads is restored from the sender code, as each entry's restored list says. Nothing else is edited.
